messages:
sara: quick question — seeing wrong API key used when instantiating multiple AsyncClient instances that read keys from env. repro attached.

sara: ```python
import os, asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY"] = "user-A"
os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY_ALT"] = "service-B"

c1 = AsyncClient(api_key_env="REDWOOD_API_KEY")   # expects user-A
c2 = AsyncClient(api_key_env="REDWOOD_API_KEY_ALT")  # expects service-B

await asyncio.gather(c1.generate("hi"), c2.generate("hi"))
# sometimes both requests use "user-A" (seen on macOS + Linux, async concurrency)
```

devon: hmm — thanks for the repro. I suspect a lazy/eager eval bug: AsyncClient default is doing api_key_env = os.getenv(... ) at import time or there's a shared _session with default headers copied once.

devon: quick grep: redwood/async_client.py has `API_KEY = os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")` at top-level. that's the culprit — evaluated once. we should prefer runtime lookup or explicit precedence.

matt: i can repro locally. also noticed when using typed overloads, the constructor signature hides the env behavior which caught me off guard. my trace shows headers from the first-created client reused in second when requests are concurrent.

matt: short fix suggestion:
```diff
- API_KEY = os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")
+ API_KEY = None
@@
- def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = API_KEY, api_key_env: str = "REDWOOD_API_KEY"):
+ def __init__(self, api_key: str | None = None, api_key_env: str = "REDWOOD_API_KEY"):
+     if api_key is None:
+         api_key = os.getenv(api_key_env)
+     self.api_key = api_key
+     self._session = create_session(per_client_headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"})
```

alex: thanks, that looks right. also think we should add a constructor param priority doc (explicit > api_key_env > global env var) and add a typed `from_env(name: str)` factory that returns typed AsyncClient for clarity.

alex: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-python/pull/4123 with the lazy-eval + per-session header change, added unit tests for concurrent instantiation.

ci-bot: build passed for PR #4123 — 3 new tests (concurrency/env precedence) ✅

sara: awesome — can you also add a short sample to devex docs showing two clients with different keys? that would've saved us some time.

devon: will follow up with docs + changelog entry. we should also update typing comment to explicitly mark `api_key: str | None` and add a one-line note in upgrade guide about avoiding top-level env reads.

matt: adding :thumbsup: and will run integration tests with dedicated env rotation flow.

sara: thanks team :pray: — marking as resolved for now, will reopen if flake reproduces in prod.
